📺 Black Bird (2022)

Black Bird follows Jimmy Keene, a charismatic former high school football star whose life takes a dramatic turn when he is sentenced to prison for drug-related crimes. Facing a lengthy sentence, Jimmy receives an extraordinary offer from federal authorities: transfer to a maximum-security prison for dangerous criminals, befriend suspected serial killer Larry Hall, and convince him to reveal the locations of his victims’ bodies. In exchange, Jimmy could earn his freedom. As he enters a terrifying environment filled with dangerous inmates, he must gain Larry’s trust without revealing his true intentions. With time running out and his own safety at risk, Jimmy becomes trapped in an intense psychological battle where one wrong move could cost him everything. Starring Taron Egerton, Paul Walter Hauser, and Ray Liotta, the series delivers gripping suspense, powerful performances, and a chilling true-crime story about manipulation, justice, survival, and the search for truth.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Thriller • Biography

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 48–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Dennis Lehane

📺 Seasons: 1 • 6 Episodes

📚 Based On: The autobiographical book In with the Devil by James Keene and Hillel Levin.

🏆 Awards: Paul Walter Hauser won a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Limited Series.

📺 Where to Watch: Apple TV+ in the United States.
